name: Photo Synth 2 (HTML)
description: Play four photos: colour becomes tone — mono/unison (1-12 stacked voices) or true 4-note polyphony with 1-4 oscillators per note — plus filter, envelope (to amplitude, filter sweep or both) and an FX photo whose red/green/blue strengths drive three chosen effects. Selectable waveforms (photo-morph, sine, triangle, sawtooth, square), a transparent output limiter, and seven switchable stereo FX: tube, vintage phaser, vintage chorus, stutter, lofi (crush/noise/dirt), clean/tape delay with L/R offset, and room/hall/plate/spring/reverse reverb; five filter modes including notch and comb. On-device presets with photo snapshots and file export, motion automation, live camera, a hardware MIDI keyboard (velocity, sustain pedal and pitch bend), MIDI chords, 24-bit WAV export.
note: Also available as a native VST3 plugin. On iPhone, sound follows the ring/silent switch.
